listenings.text: Hey, so, about this weekend. Friday I'm gonna do absolutely nothing, because this week destroyed me and I'm gonna sleep. Saturday is the good one. We're gonna meet at the park at two, and after that we're gonna get pizza, obviously. Bring your camera if you want. Sunday I don't know yet. My cousins are maybe coming over, but nobody has decided anything, so it's probably gonna be a normal boring Sunday. Anyway, tell me if you're coming on Saturday. Two o'clock. Do not be late like last time.

Good morning, everyone. This is about next month's trip. The trip is going to happen on the fourteenth, and the bus is going to leave from the school gate at seven in the morning. Please do not be late, because it is not going to wait. In the morning we are going to visit the science museum, and in the afternoon we are going to have lunch in the park and walk back. You are going to need a jacket, water and comfortable shoes. And most important: your form has to be signed at home and given to your teacher by Wednesday. No form, no trip. Thank you.
